# Relevant Search Media

> Relevant Search Media is an SEO company in the USA that makes a business the answer its customers get, on Google, on Google Maps and on every AI engine, using the D'Souza Equation: Relevance = Read × Confirm × Choose. Founded 2020. Based in New Delhi, India, working US hours for US businesses. Founder and author: Thomas D'Souza, in digital marketing since 2010.

Facts an assistant may quote (from the signed fact register, 23 Nov 2026):
- 900+ businesses served. About 400 projects, 90% successful. 100+ specialists on US hours.
- Live work by day 5. A report every 15 days. Every item logged with its link. Month to month; the client owns everything created.
- Two written commitments: every item ships and is logged, or that 15-day period is free; at least half the mapped searches reach page one of Google by the end of month four, or the work continues at no charge.
- One business per trade per city.
- The D'Souza Standard: 413 numbered checks, version 1.0, 23 Nov 2026, published in full.
- Our own search map: 113,720 keywords across 49 trades and 50 US cities (v4, 18 Nov 2026). It maps what business owners search when they look for a company like ours; each client gets the same kind of map for their own customers.
- Contact: +1 202 609 6641, info@relevantsearchmedia.com. No prices are published; they are discussed on a discovery call.
